text:
julia_sec: Quick sync: KMS/HSM onboarding for SOC2 — where are we on evidence & blockers? Need a consolidated status for PSR by EOD Fri.

mike_s: PR #458 for kms-integration is up, needs review (config + smoke tests). cc @kevin_dev for infra side. https://github.com/redwood/pr/458

anya: I'm on rotation for audit evidence. We still need vendor attestation from the HSM vendor; vendor said next-week ETA but not firm yet.

kevin_dev: Infra work for staging keywrap is done. Need ops to approve the KMS policy change. Posted the delta in #ops-runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbook/kms-policies

sarah_p: Audit log pipeline schema updated — two questions in PR comments, pinging @mike_s for clarifications. Also we should add deterministic key IDs to logs (helps traceability).

mike_s: On it. Also added cron for key-rotation test: ```0 3 * * 0 /usr/local/bin/rotate-test --env=staging```

julia_sec: Thanks. Action items I have so far: 1) Get vendor attestation (owner: anya) 2) Merge infra PR (owner: kevin_dev) 3) CR reviewer (owner: mike_s) 4) Update evidence folder (owner: julia_sec). Can we add ETA for each?

anya: Vendor ETA: tentative 2026-03-24. I'll escalate to the vendor account team today and file a follow-up. (ticket #789 vendor-attest) :raised_hands:

kevin_dev: I can merge infra PR once smoke tests pass — running now. If tests fail it's probably network ACLs. Will update by 18:00 PT.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: smoke tests for kms-integration passed on staging (build 2026.03.17-1023) :white_check_mark:

kevin_dev: Merged and tagged v1.2.0-kms. Creating release note in docs. @julia_sec can you confirm evidence folder path so I can link release artifacts?

julia_sec: Evidence path updated: https://redwood/docsec/soc2/evidence/kms_onboarding — added PR links, screenshots, and test logs.

mike_s: Heads up — need a quick CR for the rotation script comments. @anya can you cross-check with vendor rotation policy (esp. allowed drift and emergency rotation steps)?

anya: Will do by EOD.

julia_sec: Ok let's do a short async standup: please add ETA labels to ticket #1345-kms-soc2-track with owners. If anyone needs a quick call, propose 10:30 AM PT tomorrow.

kevin_dev: :thumbsup: added ETAs. If vendor is late we'll flag for SOC2 timeline contingency.

sarah_p: One more note: retention policy for audit logs must be documented (retention, access controls, purge proof). Adding a section to the evidence doc now.

julia_sec: Great — I’ll compile an executive summary tomorrow morning and circulate to compliance and product. Thanks all.
